title: Nourishing Silky Moroccan Peach Sellou
description: A comforting Moroccan dish featuring peach juice and dum, made in a claypot and suitable for a Jain diet. This briny and silky sellou is a unique and delicious experience.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large claypot, mix together the peach juice, dum, almond oil, honey, rose water, and orange blossom water.
Stir well to combine and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Stir in the sesame seeds and coconut flakes.
Transfer the claypot to the preheated oven and bake for 10 minutes.
Remove the sellou from the oven and let it cool to room temperature.
Serve the sellou warm or at room temperature, garnished with additional sesame seeds and coconut flakes if desired.
